name: Angel or Devil -Can we fall in Love in 7 days?-
source:
It was supposed to be a typical day... When I opened my eyes, I found myself in bed at the hospital - I had been involved in a car accident. All of a sudden, three strange men appeared in front of me - Latis, an angel with shining wings; Diaval, a demon with deep black wings who was smirking; Ruvel, a reaper with a scythe in his hand whose eyes were cold. They asked for my soul because I had only a few days left to live. Is it true I’m going to die? My last 7 days with these men… What will it be like? I will go to heaven or hell or...?

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nttsolmare.game.android.aod]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
这本来应该是典型的一天……当我睁开眼睛时，我发现自己躺在医院的床上——我遭遇了一场车祸。突然，三个陌生的男人出现在我面前——拉蒂斯，有着闪亮翅膀的天使；迪亚瓦尔，一个有着深黑色翅膀、正在傻笑的恶魔；鲁维尔，一个手握镰刀、目光冰冷的收割者。他们索要我的灵魂，因为我的生命只剩下几天了。我真的要死了吗？我和这些人在一起的最后7天……会是什么样子？我会去天堂还是地狱还是……？
